title: AutoML Pipeline — Schema Inference + Optuna HPO + MLflow Tracking

modules.dataset: Automated schema inference engine (ColumnType detection: numeric/categorical/datetime/binary/text/id) + task type inference (classification ≤20 unique vs regression) + synthetic generators for both tasks with mixed-type features + missingness injection.
modules.model: AutoFeatureTransformer (imputation + OneHot + StandardScaler + PolynomialFeatures + datetime decomposition). OptunaHPO (TPE sampler across LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost, 6+ hyperparameters per model). MLflowTracker (logs params + metrics + artifacts per trial + best run). run_automl_pipeline orchestrates the full flow.
modules.tests: 15 tests: schema detection (5 types), task type inference (classification/regression), feature transformer output shape + polynomial expansion, Optuna best_score = max(all_scores), trial count matches n_trials, MLflow experiment + run logging, model factory (LightGBM/XGBoost), CLI smoke.

entry_point: python train.py [--csv data.csv] [--target col] [--task classification|regression] [--n-trials 20] --use-mlflow --model-out models/best.joblib
